messages:
Maya (Support): flags up — customer ACME reported embedding shape mismatch after they pinned a model variant. they say their index stopped accepting vectors ~10:02 UTC.
Tom (SRE): link to the ticket?
Maya (Support): https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CS-8123 - error in logs: 
```
{"error":"embedding length mismatch: expected 1536, got 1024"}
```
Maya (Support): customer says this started right after pinning `open-emb-lite-v2@pin-2026-02-12`. payload snippet they used: 
```
POST /v1/embeddings
{
  "model": "open-emb-lite-v2@pin-2026-02-12",
  "input": ["doc1","doc2"],
  "batch_size": 16
}
```
acme_prod_bot: Automated deploy note: canary rollout of emb-catalog changes at 2026-02-12T09:57:10Z by @lin_deploy (inspected variants mapping).
Alex (Customer Success): customer can share a small repro. they provided one file with 2 docs -> got embedding vectors length 1024. they expect 1536 per their old contract.
Raj (ML): quick thought — open-emb-lite-v2 has two published variants: `lite-1024` and `standard-1536`. pin name looks like it might have pointed to the lite variant. did we resolve pinned alias -> concrete variant?
Lin (Runtime): checking variant-resolution logs for that pin now. if routing layer silently fell back to lite variant on host mismatch, batch path might still report successful call but shorter vector.
Tom (SRE): can we repro by forcing the pinned name locally? even a curl should show returned vector len. Maya, can you run quick curl and paste response?
Maya (Support): ran this: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDACTED" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"open-emb-lite-v2@pin-2026-02-12","input":["hello"]}'
```
Response: 
```
{"data":[{"embedding":[/* 1024 floats here */]}],"model":"open-emb-lite-v2@pin-2026-02-12"}
```
Maya (Support): so the API is returning 1024 currently. customer insists previous behavior was 1536 for this pin.
Raj (ML): that suggests the pin was created when `open-emb-lite-v2` pointed to `standard-1536`, but later catalog rebased the tag to `lite-1024`. pins should be immutable — suspect bug in pin-to-variant mapping table (not the pin store).
Lin (Runtime): found mapping entry: pin-2026-02-12 -> variant id `v-20260212-lite-1024` in the runtime cache, but the pin metadata service shows `v-20260212-std-1536`. caching inconsistency between control-plane and runtime. the cache TTL was 0 but we had an invalidation bug during canary.
Tom (SRE): DeployBot, any canary events around invalidation?
DeployBot: Canary rollout for emb-catalog failed at step 3; automated cache invalidation hook retried but returned 500 twice. Full rollout paused at 09:58 UTC.
Lin (Runtime): that matches. runtime cache didn't get the correct mapping and used a fallback mapping that picks `lite-1024` when missing metadata. batcher code pads/truncates at host-level and does not validate final embedding width — it just forwards the vector. that's why caller gets 1024 instead of an error.
Raj (ML): immediate mitigation options: 1) update runtime cache from control plane explicit refresh for affected hosts; 2) temporarily unpin for customer and re-pin to explicit variant id (not alias); 3) add runtime validation to reject mismatched widths.
Alex (Customer Success): customer asked for hotfix asap. which is fastest?
Tom (SRE): fastest is #1 — force refresh of mapping on those gateways and restart the cache workers for the affected region. I'll run a refresh and monitor.
Lin (Runtime): I'll also push a quick check that compares declared embedding_size in model manifest vs runtime-produced vector; if mismatch, return 502 and log metrics. need a 10-min patch, canary to a single host.
Maya (Support): communicated to customer: we have mitigation plan, doing refresh now, will follow up in 30m.
Tom (SRE): refresh complete on region-us-east-1 gateways at 10:15 UTC. initial recheck: pinned name now resolves to `v-20260212-std-1536`.
Maya (Support): re-ran curl -> response vector length is 1536 now. customer confirms index accepted the vectors again. :tada:
Alex (Customer Success): customer super relieved, asked for postmortem and SLA credit request. routing them to acct mgr.
Lin (Runtime): follow-ups: add runtime validation in 1-2 days, add observability alert if resolved pin -> variant width differs from previously recorded customer usage, and fix invalidation hook in canary flow.
Raj (ML): filing follow-up issue to audit all pinned variants for divergence between control plane and runtime.
Maya (Support): closing loop with customer now. will add reproduction snippets and timeline to the ticket.
acme_prod_bot: Customer ACME confirmation: "works now — thanks. we'd like a summary and confirmation pin immutability guarantees."
Maya (Support): noted for PM/Legal.
Tom (SRE): marking incident as P2 internal; root cause: cache invalidation bug caused runtime to serve fallback variant with smaller embedding width; mitigation applied by forcing mapping refresh and runtime patch planned.
Raj (ML): tagging model-catalog, runtime-cache, support for postmortem action items.
Maya (Support): thanks all.
